commitments.label: Monthly, no minimum term
commitments.renewal: Renews every month until you cancel.
commitments.note: Most flexible, and the highest monthly price.

commitments.renewal: After 12 months it automatically continues as a monthly membership unless you cancel.
commitments.note: Cannot be paused, and cannot be downgraded during the 12 months.

rules.cancellationNotice: At least 72 hours before the end of your billing period. Cancel later than that and the membership runs for one more month.
rules.accessEnds: You keep access until 11:59 pm on the day before your cancellation date. Unused days are not refunded.
rules.pause: Monthly memberships can be paused for 1 to 6 full months at no cost, requested at least one day before your next billing date. 12-month and 24-month memberships cannot be paused.
rules.upgrade: You can upgrade at any time and it takes effect immediately. Upgrading does not extend a 12-month term.
rules.downgrade: Downgrades take effect at the start of your next membership month, and are not possible during a 12-month term.
rules.sameVenue: You can check in once per day at the same venue. Each venue also has its own monthly visit limit, which depends on your plan.
rules.visitLimitReset: Visit limits run with the calendar month and reset on the 1st. Unused visits do not carry over.
